title: Airfare of the Week: Qantas Premium Economy Brisbane – Santiago from $3,198 Return
body:
Australian Frequent Flyer
Australian Frequent Flyer - Tips, Tricks and Chat for Australian Frequent Flyers
Santiago, Chile. Photo: Alisha Lubben from Pexels.
Our newest Airfare of the Week belongs to Qantas, which has round-trip Premium Economy fares from Brisbane (BNE) to Santiago (SCL) from $3,198.
Qantas is currently having an International Red Tail Sale with sale fares across many popular routes. As Qantas is a member of the Oneworld alliance, you can earn Qantas Points & status credits with this fare, as well as points in other Oneworld programs.
Here are the full details of this great Premium Economy airfare from Brisbane to Santiago.
Sample itinerary & pricing
Example pricing. Screenshot from Google Flights
You can book this fare on the Qantas website .
Fares from Sydney, Melbourne and Adelaide are available at similar prices. If you prefer to fly Business Class, fares start from $5,328.
Note that fares and availability are subject to change. This fare may not be available by the time you read this article, and you might need to be flexible with travel dates. We recommend booking ASAP to avoid disappointment!
Travel dates & fare rules
Here are the details of this airfare:
Book by 16 November 2026
Depart Australia by 10 December 2026, or between 30 December 2026 and 2 October 2027
Blackout dates returning to Australia: 1-31 January 2027, 18-30 September 2027 and 9-21 October 2027
No minimum stay
Maximum stay of 12 months
Stopovers permitted in each direction (one free, then $100 each)
Changes cost $250 plus any fare difference
Cancellations cost $450, and the ticket is non-refundable if you don’t show up for your flight
On-board product
Qantas flies its Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner between Sydney and Santiago. Premium Economy is in a 2-3-2 layout, with 38 inches of seat pitch. The seat also includes a bigger entertainment screen than Economy Class with adjustable headrest and footrest.
On-board service includes premium meals and drinks throughout the flight, and you also get an amenity kit.
Qantas 787 Premium Economy recline. Photo: Qantas
The domestic sectors between Brisbane and Sydney will be in Economy Class and operated by narrow-body Boeing 737 or Airbus A321XLR aircraft.
Qantas Boeing 737-800 Economy Class. Photo: Matt Graham.
Earning points & status credits with this airfare
This fare books into “T” class, which Qantas Frequent Flyer counts as Discount Premium Economy. As Qantas is a member of Oneworld, you could earn points and status credits for this airfare in programs including:
Qantas Frequent Flyer
British Airways Club
American Airlines AAdvantage
Alaska Atmos Rewards
For example, if you credited these flights to Qantas Frequent Flyer, you could earn at least 17,400 Qantas Points and 200 status credits. The other Oneworld programs mentioned above will accrue at least 7,547 redeemable miles or points.
